reason: A dsh plugin for managing global and per-session linked folders through a web sidebar and model tools, making selected directory roots available in session context without changing the documented file sandbox.

summaries.zh: 通过 Web 侧边栏和模型工具管理全局及会话级链接文件夹，并将选定目录加入会话上下文。
summaries.en: Manages global and per-session linked folders through a web sidebar and model tools, adding selected directory roots to session context.

capabilities: Manages persistent global and temporary linked-folder paths
Adds linked-folder information to the model system prompt
Provides link_folder and unlink_folder model tools
Provides a web sidebar for selecting and removing linked folders
Optionally patches a compiled workspace-picker bundle
